data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As on April 03, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 58.29 lakh ha as compared to 57.80 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 30.12 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year.
-  As on 27.03.2026, 32.26% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over India. Approximately 67% area  of  Pulses  mainly  in  Gram  (66%),  Urdbean  (86%)  &  Moong  (63%);  71.56%  area  of  Oilseeds majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (75.53%); 38.31% area of Shri Anna cum Coarse Cereals majorly in Jowar (54.47%), 25.57% area of Rice and 6.00% area of Wheat  has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (03 April - 09 April 2026):
data.text: -  Maximum Temperature is likely to be above normal in North East India, many parts of Bihar, many parts of J&K and in coastal regions of Odisha, Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Kerala.

data.heading: Week 2 (10 April - 16 April 2026):
data.text:
-  Low Probability  of  Heat  Wave  conditions  likely  during  the  second  half  of  the  week  over  Coastal Odisha and adjoining north Coastal Andhra Pradesh.
-  Appreciably  above  normal  (+3.1  to  +5.0°C)  maximum  temperatures  are  likely  over  some  parts  of interior & coastal Odisha and adjoining Coastal Andhra Pradesh; normal to above-normal maximum temperatures ((+1.6 to +3.0°C) are likely over some parts of the East, South and Western parts of India (Gangetic West Bengal, Odisha, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, southern parts of Kerala, coastal  regions  of  Gujarat  state,  Konkan,  Goa  and  coastal  Karnataka).  Normal  to  below  normal weekly maximum temperatures are likely across the rest of the country.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice : About 30.12 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 32.59 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses :  About  8.79  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  7.02  lakh  ha  during  the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds :  About 7.74 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 7.42 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
